summary.verdict_desc: 本周计数 6 红 / 8 黄 / 11 绿，红灯比例连续第 3 期钉在 24.0%、加权风险分维持 40.0%，聚合无一指标发生颜色迁移（动量净 0）。但『表面平静』掩盖了一次教科书式的『滞胀预演』：本周真正发生的，是一场中途点燃、又被迅速浇灭的加息恐慌，以及市场趁势 melt-up 到历史新高。序列如下——油价突破 $100 触发通胀担忧，8/4 CME FedWatch 对 9 月加息的定价一度飙至约 55-82%（一周前仅约 1/3），8/5 道指应声跌逾 450 点、结束五连涨；随后 8/8 一份意外疲软的 7 月非农（实际 -2.3 万 vs 预期 +8.3 万，且前值大幅下修 14.6 万、累计较预期缺口约 25.2 万）令加息预期瞬间崩塌，9 月『维持』概率回到约 60%，股市反手冲高——S&P 500 周五收 7757.64 创历史新高、全周 +3.6%，纳指全周 +5.2%（芯片反弹领动）。也就是说，本周宏观从『通胀过热→加息』的单边叙事，切换成『增长转弱 + 油价通胀』的双边（滞胀）叙事，风险两侧同时加大，而市场选择拥抱『弱就业=Fed 不会很快加息=risk-on』的一面。宏观判读（本周最重要的新信息）：fed_policy 维持黄灯——下次会议（9/16）隐含动作仍是维持（约 60% 概率），未达『隐含加息=红』门槛；但整条曲线转鹰（10 月加息约 55%、12 月约 75%），叠加油价通胀，是黄区内的边际恶化，同时就业转弱把滞胀风险摆上台面。估值端在 melt-up 中再拉伸：CAPE 约 42.0（GuruFocus 42.03、multpl 42.39、MarketCrash 42.19），较上周约 41.0 续升、逼近 2000 峰值 44.2（仅差约 5%），为 150 年次高；S&P 前 5 大权重约 28%（NVDA 约 7.6% 居首、MSFT 约 6.9%、AAPL 约 6.4%），集中度续处纪录；唯 NVDA 远期 PE 约 23x 维持绿灯（剔一处 42.02 疑似误标 trailing 的异常读）。资金面仍是最大压力源（类别分 87.5、3 红）：Mag4 FCF 红灯（Meta Q2 FCF -91%、Amazon TTM 转负、仅 MSFT 正）、AI 占全球 VC 约 70%（美国 H1 86%）、NVDA 客户投资/收入约 43%——且本指标二阶由『收敛』反转回『再扩张』：WSJ 7/27 披露 Nvidia 拟为 OpenAI 俄亥俄 $500B 项目提供 $250B 融资担保 + 约 $350B 芯片采购融资，从直接股权转向贷款背书，financing web 再度膨胀，循环融资口实升级。信用面整体仍是最强支撑（类别分 25.0）：宽口径 HY OAS 反收窄至约 272bps（Convex 8/6 271、TradingEconomics 273，环比 -12bps，续处最紧十分位，绿）；但要害处继续冒烟——CoreWeave 5 年期 CDS 仍约 855bps、隐含约 50% 违约概率（月内 -36%、Nebius -43%，Q1 利息支出翻倍至 $536M、FCF -$47.1 亿、债务 $251 亿），neocloud 维持黄灯（观察，仍无已确认降级/违约，Nebius 现金 $93.7 亿、流动性稳）。debt_capex_ratio 本周做满 28 天完整对账（上次 7/6，距今 34 天）：MS 全口径 2026E 新增债务锚定约 $570B（YTD 5 月底 $236B、约上年 4x；S&P 口径 hyperscaler+Nvidia 公开债 YTD 约 $225B、31 家发行人在外债券 $576B+）÷ 全口径 capex 约 $1.04T ≈ 55%（区间 50-60%），低于互联网/电信顶 80-100%，维持黄灯，last_full_recon 更新为 8/9；本周债市焦点 Oracle $38B 数据中心债务包（Vantage 德州 $23.25B + 威州 $14.75B，JPM/MUFG 牵头，供 OpenAI 托管）正在市场推进，为迄今最大单笔 AI 基建债（属锚定内明细、不重复加总）。市场结构：广度 S5FI 周中 8/7 一度回落至约 58.3%（油价扰动），周五随记录新高修复，全周区间约 58-72%、估约 62%，维持绿灯但转 choppy、软化约 -13% WoW，为需盯的软信号；内部人卖压维持红灯，openinsider 连续第 4 周 egress 受限、12 家 30 日聚合美元比仍无法精确获取、买盘归零，约 25x 为方向性估算（连续第 4 期同值）→ 标 suspect_static，需人工核查。基本面维持类别分 8.3：token 绝对量本周无全新独立读数（openrouter/rankings 仍 403，沿用约 125T/月量级、无收缩，绿）；GPU 现货由上期『边际转松』反转回 firm——H100 on-demand 回升逼近 $3、需求强、无过剩（绿）；ARR 二阶导维持黄（Anthropic 约 $74B 已反超 OpenAI、月增量回落至 +$4.5B，OpenAI 确认约 $2B/月）；云 RPO 强劲加速、前沿进展仍偏加速（HLE 一年 +30pp、METR 倍增约 4 月轨道、旗舰密集）。判读：基础档位按 red_pct 24.0%（<25）本落在观察期，但估值 2 红（CAPE、Top-5）叠加资金面 3 红（FCF、VC AI 占比、NVDA 客户投资）触发估值 + 资金面双类共振强制升级，维持高风险预警。两轴升级（stage≥60 且 trigger≥50）因 trigger 仅 26.7 未触发；两轴仍为泡沫成熟度 60.0（亢奋 Euphoria）+ 破裂临近度 26.7（零星火花 Sparks）。历史相似度：本期颜色向量与上周完全一致，最像 2000-02（顶前 1 个月，76%），次 1999-06（70%）、2021-11（68%），2007-10（41%）最不像。与 2000-02（顶前 1 个月）向量的主要差异（即接下来确认进入顶部前夜要盯的信号）：NVDA 远期 PE 仍便宜（约 23x vs 2000 龙头约 60x）、市场广度仍绿（虽转 choppy）、宽口径 HY 信用仍紧（272bps vs 2000 走阔）、IPO 未成洪流（Anthropic 瞄准 10 月、OpenAI 倾向 2027）、Fed 为维持而非明确加息——本周这些差异多数未变，其中最接近收窄的是 Fed（鹰派曲线 + 油价通胀）与信用/循环融资（Nvidia $250B 背书、Oracle $38B 债包、CoreWeave CDS）。分母提醒：N=25 下 6 红对应 24.0%，跨期趋势以方向为主。一句话：头条连续 3 期钉在 24% 红灯，但这份平静里藏着一次滞胀预演——油价点燃加息恐慌、又被疲软就业浇灭，市场趁势 melt-up 创历史新高；真正在积累的不是红灯数量，而是估值再拉伸（CAPE 42）、Fed 曲线转鹰、以及循环融资/信用审视的升级（Nvidia $250B 背书、Oracle $38B 债包、CoreWeave CDS 855bps）。（动量净 0，无色变，未及 ±4 阈值。）
summary.verdict_desc_en: This week prints 6 red / 8 yellow / 11 green, with the red share pinned at 24.0% for a third straight reading and the weighted risk score holding at 40.0% — not a single indicator changed color (net momentum 0). But the surface calm masks a textbook 'stagflation dress rehearsal': what actually happened this week was a rate-hike scare that lit mid-week and was doused by Friday, and a market that melted up to fresh record highs in the process. The sequence: oil topped $100 and stoked inflation fears; on Aug 4, CME FedWatch briefly priced September hike odds at ~55-82% (from just one-in-three a week earlier); the Dow fell more than 450 points on Aug 5, ending a five-day win streak. Then, on Aug 8, a surprisingly weak July jobs report (an actual loss of 23k versus +83k expected, with 146k of downward revisions to prior months, a ~252k cumulative shortfall) collapsed hike expectations, pushing the September 'hold' probability back to ~60% — and stocks ripped higher, with the S&P 500 closing at a record 7,757.64 on Friday (+3.6% on the week) and the Nasdaq up 5.2% (led by a chip rebound). In other words, the macro narrative flipped from a one-sided 'inflation-overheating → hike' story to a two-sided (stagflationary) one — growth softening plus oil inflation — with risk rising on both tails, and the market chose to embrace the 'weak jobs = the Fed won't hike soon = risk-on' side. Macro read (the week's most important new information): fed_policy stays yellow — the next meeting (Sept 16) still implies a hold (~60%), short of the 'implied hike = red' threshold; but the whole curve turned hawkish (Oct hike ~55%, Dec ~75%) and, layered on oil-driven inflation, is a marginal deterioration within the yellow band, while the soft jobs print puts stagflation risk on the table. Valuations stretched further in the melt-up: CAPE ~42.0 (GuruFocus 42.03, multpl 42.39, MarketCrash 42.19), up from ~41.0 and now only ~5% below the 2000 peak of 44.2 — the second-highest in 150 years; the S&P Top-5 weight is ~28% (NVDA #1 at ~7.6%, MSFT ~6.9%, AAPL ~6.4%), a record concentration; only NVDA's ~23x forward PE stays green (one 42.02 reading discarded as a likely mislabeled trailing figure). Capital remains the biggest pressure point (category 87.5, three reds): Mag4 FCF red (Meta Q2 FCF -91%, Amazon TTM negative, only MSFT positive), AI ~70% of global VC (86% of US H1), and NVDA customer-financing ~43% of revenue — with the second-order move reversing from 'contracting' back to 're-expanding': the WSJ reported July 27 that Nvidia is in talks to provide a $250B financing guarantee for OpenAI's $500B Ohio project plus ~$350B of chip-purchase financing, shifting from direct equity into loan backstops and re-inflating the financing web, escalating the circular-financing critique. Credit remains the strongest overall support (category 25.0): broad HY OAS actually tightened to ~272bps (Convex 271 on Aug 6, TradingEconomics 273, -12bps, still in the tightest decile, green); but the pressure point keeps smoking — CoreWeave's 5-year CDS is still ~855bps, implying ~50% default probability (the stock down 36% on the month, Nebius -43%, Q1 interest expense doubling to $536M, FCF -$4.71B, debt $25.1B), with neocloud credit holding yellow (Watch — still no confirmed downgrade or default; Nebius sits on $9.37B cash and stable liquidity). The debt_capex_ratio completed its 28-day full reconciliation this week (last on July 6, 34 days ago): MS's all-in 2026E new AI debt anchors at ~$570B (YTD $236B through May, ~4x the prior year; S&P counts ~$225B of hyperscaler+Nvidia public bonds YTD and 31 issuers with $576B+ outstanding) over ~$1.04T of all-in capex ≈ 55% (50-60% range), below the 80-100% dot-com/telecom peak — stays yellow, and last_full_recon is updated to Aug 9; the week's debt-market focus is Oracle's $38B data-center package (Vantage: $23.25B in Texas + $14.75B in Wisconsin, JPM/MUFG-led, to host OpenAI), the largest single AI-infrastructure debt deal to date, now advancing in-market (a component within the anchor, not double-counted). Market structure: S5FI breadth dipped mid-week to ~58.3% (Aug 7, on the oil scare) and recovered with Friday's record close, running a ~58-72% range and ~62% estimated end-of-week — stays green but turns choppy, softening ~-13% WoW, a soft signal to watch; insider selling stays red, with openinsider egress-blocked for a fourth straight week, the 12-name 30-day aggregate dollar ratio still unobtainable and buying at zero, so ~25x is a directional estimate (a fourth straight identical value) and is flagged suspect-static, pending manual review. Fundamentals hold at category 8.3: no fresh independent token read this week (openrouter.ai/rankings still 403), carrying the ~125T/month level with no contraction (green); GPU spot prices reversed last period's marginal softening back to firm — H100 on-demand climbing toward $3 on strong demand with no glut (green); the ARR second derivative holds yellow (Anthropic ~$74B has overtaken OpenAI, monthly increment easing to +$4.5B; OpenAI confirms ~$2B/month); cloud RPO is strong and accelerating, and frontier progress stays on-trend-to-accelerating (HLE +30pp in a year, METR doubling on a ~4-month track, flagships clustered). Verdict: the base framework sits at Observation on red_pct of 24.0% (<25), but valuation 2-red (CAPE, Top-5) plus capital 3-red (FCF, VC AI share, NVDA customer-financing) fire the dual-category resonance override, holding the verdict at High Risk Alert. The two-axis upgrade (stage>=60 and trigger>=50) does not fire because trigger is only 26.7; the axes remain bubble maturity 60.0 (Euphoria) and rupture proximity 26.7 (Sparks). Historical similarity: the color vector is identical to last week, most resembling February 2000 (one month before the top, 76%), then June 1999 (70%) and November 2021 (68%), with October 2007 (41%) least alike. The main differences versus the February 2000 vector — the signals to watch to confirm entry into the top's eve — are: NVDA's forward PE still cheap (~23x vs ~60x for 2000's leaders), market breadth still green (if choppy), broad HY credit still tight (272bps vs widening in 2000), the IPO pipeline not yet a flood (Anthropic targets October, OpenAI leans 2027), and the Fed holding rather than clearly hiking — most of these gaps were unchanged this week, with the ones narrowing fastest being the Fed (hawkish curve plus oil inflation) and credit/circular-financing (Nvidia's $250B backstop, Oracle's $38B package, CoreWeave's CDS). Denominator reminder: with N=25 the six reds map to 24.0%, so cross-period trend comparison should lean on direction. In one line: the headline is pinned at a 24% red share for a third straight week, but inside that calm was a stagflation dress rehearsal — oil lit a hike scare that weak jobs doused, and the market melted up to record highs; what is actually accumulating is not the red count but stretched valuations (CAPE 42), a hawkish-tilting Fed curve, and escalating circular-financing/credit scrutiny (Nvidia's $250B backstop, Oracle's $38B package, CoreWeave's 855bps CDS). (Net momentum 0, no color changes, below the ±4 threshold.)

wow_changes.note: 本周债市焦点、迄今最大单笔 AI 基建债务包：Oracle 拟获 $38B 数据中心债务融资（Vantage 建设的德州 $23.25B + 威州 $14.75B 两笔高级担保信贷，JPM/MUFG 牵头，Oracle 承租用于托管 OpenAI），正在市场推进。同期完成 28 天完整对账：MS 全口径 2026E 新增债务约 $570B ÷ 全口径 capex 约 $1.04T ≈ 55%，维持黄灯（Oracle 包属锚定内明细、不重复加总分子）
wow_changes.note_en: The week's debt-market focus and the largest single AI-infrastructure debt package to date: Oracle is set to receive $38B of data-center debt (two senior secured facilities on Vantage-built sites — $23.25B in Texas and $14.75B in Wisconsin, JPM/MUFG-led, with Oracle leasing to host OpenAI), now advancing in-market. The 28-day full reconciliation completed alongside it: MS's all-in 2026E new AI debt ~$570B over ~$1.04T of all-in capex ≈ 55%, stays yellow (the Oracle package is a component within the anchor, not added on top of the numerator)

wow_changes.note: 市场广度转 choppy：S5FI 周中 8/7 因油价冲击一度回落至约 58.3%，周五 8/8 随 S&P 记录新高（全周 +3.6%、纳指 +5.2%）修复，全周区间约 58-72%、估约 62%，环比软化约 -13% 但仍守绿（>60）。头部与广度本周同向创高，暂无 2000 式头部独撑，但由 71.6% 回落是需盯的软信号
wow_changes.note_en: Market breadth turned choppy: S5FI dipped mid-week to ~58.3% (Aug 7) on the oil shock, then recovered with Friday's record S&P close (+3.6% on the week, Nasdaq +5.2%), running a ~58-72% range and ~62% estimated end-of-week — down ~13% WoW but still green (>60). Index and breadth made highs together this week, with no 2000-style narrow leadership, but the pullback from 71.6% is a soft signal to watch

Dollars concentrate in a few mega-rounds far above the 50% red line — stays red

indicators.threshold_text_en: >30% red / 15-30% yellow / <15% green (Lucent '99 peak: 24%)
indicators.note: 常红处理，且本周二阶由『收敛』反转回『再扩张』：直接股权承诺仍约 $40B（OpenAI $30B）占约 $300B LTM 收入远超 Lucent 1999 峰值 24%；但 WSJ 7/27 披露 Nvidia 拟为 OpenAI 俄亥俄 $500B 项目提供 $250B 融资担保 + 约 $350B 芯片采购融资，从直接股权转向贷款背书，再加 $500B SK Group 项目——financing web 再度膨胀，循环融资口实升级，维持红灯
indicators.note_en: A persistent red, and this week the second-order move reversed from 'contracting' back to 're-expanding': direct equity commitments remain ~$40B (OpenAI $30B) against ~$300B LTM revenue, far above Lucent's 1999 peak of 24%; but the WSJ reported July 27 that Nvidia is in talks to provide a $250B financing guarantee for OpenAI's $500B Ohio project plus ~$350B of chip financing, shifting from direct equity into loan backstops, on top of a $500B SK Group project — the financing web is re-inflating and the circular-financing critique is escalating, stays red

indicators.threshold_text_en: <40% red / 40-60% yellow / >60% green
indicators.note: 广度转 choppy 但守绿：S5FI 周中 8/7 因油价冲击一度回落至约 58.3%（黄区边缘），周五 8/8 随 S&P 记录新高（全周 +3.6%、纳指 +5.2% 芯片反弹）修复，全周区间约 58-72%、估约 62%。指数与广度本周同向创高、暂无 2000 式头部独撑，维持绿灯；但由上周 71.6% 回落约 -13% 为下期需盯的软信号（barchart/investing 实时源仍受限，取周内二手读）
indicators.note_en: Breadth turned choppy but held green: S5FI dipped mid-week to ~58.3% (Aug 7, at the edge of the yellow band) on the oil shock, then recovered with Friday's record S&P close (+3.6% on the week, Nasdaq +5.2% on a chip rebound), running a ~58-72% range and ~62% estimated. Index and breadth made highs together this week with no 2000-style narrow leadership — stays green; but the ~-13% pullback from last week's 71.6% is a soft signal to watch (Barchart/Investing live sources still limited, intra-week secondary reads used)

indicators.name_zh: AI 龙头内部人卖买比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >20x = red / 5-20x = yellow / <5x = green (2000 peak: 23x)
indicators.note: 内部人卖压维持红灯，但数据源连续第 4 周不可用：openinsider 仍 egress 受限（curl CONNECT 与 WebFetch 均 403），12 家 30 日聚合卖/买美元比仍无法精确获取。具名数据点：15 名 NVDA 内部人 18 月零买入、龙头累计卖出约 $3.3B（Puri 三月 $148M、Stevens $100M+），买盘几近归零使比值远超 20x，25x 为方向性估算——连续 4 期同值且始终拿不到聚合美元总额，本期标记 suspect_static、需人工核查
indicators.note_en: Insider selling stays red, but the data source is unavailable for a fourth straight week: openinsider remained egress-blocked (both curl CONNECT and WebFetch 403), so the 12-name 30-day aggregate dollar ratio still cannot be obtained precisely. Named data points: 15 NVDA insiders with zero purchases over 18 months and ~$3.3B of trailing leader sales (Puri $148M over three months, Stevens $100M+); near-zero buying keeps the ratio well above 20x, and 25x is a directional estimate — a fourth straight identical value with the aggregate dollar total still unobtainable, so it is flagged suspect-static and needs manual review

indicators.threshold_text: 洪流=红 / 升温=黄 / 平静=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Flood = red / Warming = yellow / Quiet = green
indicators.note: 管道继续升温但未成洪流：Anthropic 领跑——6/1 交表、承销商 GS/JPM/MS 持续排会，瞄准 9 月公开 S-1、9 月-10 月初路演、10 月首挂（或成首家 $1T 估值 IPO）；OpenAI（约 $920B 保密交表）在 SpaceX 6 月破发后倾向推迟至 2027。本周无全新 AI IPO/SPAC 公告，临近发行（6 个月内）名单实质仍只 Anthropic、总数 <10，维持黄灯
indicators.note_en: The pipeline keeps warming but is short of a flood: Anthropic leads — filed June 1, its bankers (GS/JPM/MS) keep scheduling meetings, targeting a public S-1 in September, a roadshow in September-early October and a first trade in October (potentially the first $1T-valuation IPO); OpenAI (confidential filing at ~$920B) leans toward 2027 after SpaceX's rocky June debut. No brand-new AI IPO/SPAC announcement this week, and imminent (within-6-month) names are still essentially just Anthropic, under 10 total — stays yellow

indicators.threshold_text_en: >500 red / 350-500 yellow / <350 green
indicators.note: ICE BofA HY OAS 约 272bps（Convex 8/6 271、TradingEconomics 273），较上周约 284 收窄约 12bps，仍远低于长期均值约 394bps、中位数约 452bps，处历史最紧十分位。宽口径信用对 AI 风险仍无压力、是当前最支撑多头的指标，维持绿灯（但需并读边际：AI/DC 高收益债自 6 月起走阔、蓝筹 DC 债收益率抬升）
indicators.note_en: ICE BofA HY OAS is ~272bps (Convex 271 on Aug 6, TradingEconomics 273), tightening ~12bps from last week's ~284 and still far below the ~394bps average and ~452bps median, in the historically tightest decile. Broad credit shows no stress on AI risk and is the most bull-supportive indicator now — stays green (but read alongside the margin: AI/DC high-yield spreads widening since June and rising blue-chip DC-bond yields)

indicators.name_zh: 数据中心 ABS 利差
indicators.threshold_text: 走阔 50bps+ = 红 / 稳定 = 黄 / 收窄 = 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Widening 50bps+ = red / Stable = yellow / Tightening = green
indicators.note: AAA 级 DC ABS 侧仍最紧：上周 Cloud Capital 首笔三 AAA DC ABS 定价为中东冲突以来最紧，KBRA 续给新发预评级、2025 DC ABS 新发约 $27B 且 2026 供需两旺。ABS 利差未反映压力，维持绿灯——但须并记分层背离（Penn Mutual 8/6）：AI/DC 高收益债与蓝筹/公司 DC 债自 6 月起走阔，仅 AAA ABS 与大盘 IG 仍紧，DC 债券复合体成本端应力在累积
indicators.note_en: The AAA data-center ABS side stays tightest: last week Cloud Capital's first triple-AAA DC ABS priced at the tightest since the Mideast conflict, and KBRA continues to rate new issues amid a healthy ~$27B 2025 DC-ABS market and strong 2026 supply-demand. ABS spreads do not reflect stress — stays green, but note the tiering divergence (Penn Mutual, Aug 6): AI/DC high-yield and blue-chip/corporate DC bonds have widened since June while only AAA ABS and large-cap IG stay tight, so cost strain is accumulating across the DC-debt complex

indicators.threshold_text: 任何违约/降级=红 / Watch=黄 / 无=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Any default/downgrade = red / Watch = yellow / None = green
indicators.note: 维持黄灯（观察）：CoreWeave 5 年期 CDS 仍约 855bps、隐含约 50% 违约概率，月内股价 -36%、Nebius -43%；Q1 利息支出翻倍至 $536M、FCF -$47.1 亿、债务本金 $251 亿。反向：Nebius 现金 $93.7 亿、流动比 8.3x、Altman Z=7.1 稳健，S&P 前将 CoreWeave 展望调至正面。90 日内仍无已确认降级/违约，但 CDS 定价 + 深度回撤维持『观察』门槛，为信用轴持续冒烟的火星
indicators.note_en: Stays yellow (Watch): CoreWeave's 5-year CDS is still ~855bps, implying ~50% default probability, with the stock down 36% on the month and Nebius -43%; Q1 interest expense doubled to $536M, FCF was -$4.71B and debt principal $25.1B. Countervailing: Nebius holds $9.37B cash, a current ratio of 8.3x and an Altman Z of 7.1, and S&P earlier revised CoreWeave's outlook to Positive. No confirmed downgrade or default in 90 days, but the CDS pricing plus deep drawdowns keep the 'watch' threshold — the credit axis keeps smoking

indicators.name_zh: 全口径债务/Capex 流量比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >=70% red / 50-70% yellow / <50% green (dot-com peak: 80-100%)
indicators.note: 本周做满 28 天完整对账（上次 7/6，距今 34 天）：分子 = MS 全口径 2026E 新增 AI 债务约 $570B（YTD 5 月底 $236B、约上年 4x；S&P 口径 hyperscaler+Nvidia 公开债 YTD 约 $225B、31 家 AI/DC 发行人在外债券 $576B+；MS 私募信用 DC 机会 2028 前约 $800B 交叉印证），分母 = 全口径 2026E capex 约 $1.04T（Big4 $740-770B + Oracle + neoclouds + 中国/主权/其他），比值约 55%（区间 50-60%），低于互联网/电信顶 80-100%，维持黄灯。last_full_recon 更新为 8/9。本周债市焦点 Oracle $38B 数据中心债务包（Vantage 德州 $23.25B + 威州 $14.75B，JPM/MUFG，供 OpenAI 托管）为迄今最大单笔 AI 基建债、正在市场推进（属锚定内明细、不重复加总）
indicators.note_en: The 28-day full reconciliation ran this week (last on July 6, 34 days ago): numerator = MS's all-in 2026E new AI debt ~$570B (YTD $236B through May, ~4x the prior year; S&P counts ~$225B of hyperscaler+Nvidia public bonds YTD and 31 AI/DC issuers with $576B+ outstanding; MS's ~$800B private-credit DC opportunity through 2028 cross-checks it); denominator = ~$1.04T of all-in 2026E capex (Big4 $740-770B plus Oracle, neoclouds, China/sovereign/others), giving ~55% (50-60% range), below the 80-100% dot-com/telecom peak — stays yellow. last_full_recon is updated to Aug 9. The week's debt-market focus is Oracle's $38B data-center package (Vantage: $23.25B Texas + $14.75B Wisconsin, JPM/MUFG, to host OpenAI), the largest single AI-infrastructure debt deal to date, now advancing in-market (a component within the anchor, not double-counted)
indicators.source_name: Morgan Stanley + 自下而上台账

indicators.name_zh: AI 行业 Token 月度环比
indicators.threshold_text: 收缩=红 / 减速=黄 / 加速=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Contraction = red / Decel = yellow / Accel = green
indicators.note: 本周未获全新独立月度绝对量读数：openrouter.ai/rankings 仍 403，可得口径仍为约 25T/周、1.5 quadrillion/年、8M 用户（5-7 月披露），沿用约 125T/月量级、环比按持平估。行业绝对用量续处高位、无收缩迹象，维持绿灯——但须并记新鲜度：本期无 fresh read，数据约 4-8 周旧，若下期仍拿不到新绝对量将逼近静态预警
indicators.note_en: No fresh independent monthly absolute read this week: openrouter.ai/rankings still 403s, and the available figures remain ~25T/week, a ~1.5-quadrillion annual run-rate and 8M users (May-July disclosures), so the ~125T/month level is carried with a flat MoM estimate. Industry usage stays at a high level with no sign of contraction — stays green, but note the freshness caveat: no fresh read this period, data ~4-8 weeks old, and another missing absolute figure next period would approach a static-value warning

indicators.threshold_text: 环比跌>15%/供过于求=红 / 阴跌=黄 / 稳定或上涨=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: -15%+ MoM / glut = red / Drifting lower = yellow / Stable-to-rising = green
indicators.note: 较上期『边际转松』反转回 firm：H100 on-demand 回升逼近 $3（区间约 $2.19-3，spot 约 $1-2）、H200 on-demand 约 $3.99（spot 约 $1.99），DigitalCitizen 称多代 GPU 租价随需求走强而上行、无广泛过剩。算力供需最直接温度计仍偏紧、维持绿灯（Blackwell 放量仍为下期需盯的软信号）
indicators.note_en: Reversed last period's marginal softening back to firm: H100 on-demand climbing toward $3 (~$2.19-3 range, spot ~$1-2) and H200 on-demand ~$3.99 (spot ~$1.99), with DigitalCitizen reporting rental prices across GPU generations rising on strong demand and no broad glut. As the most direct thermometer of compute supply-demand it stays firm and green (a Blackwell ramp remains a soft signal to watch next period)

indicators.name_zh: AI 收入增速的二阶导
indicators.threshold_text: 减速=红 / 平稳=黄 / 加速=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Decel = red / Flat = yellow / Accel = green
indicators.note: 维持黄灯，无 8 月新披露、沿用 7 月台账：Anthropic ARR 年化约 $74.1B（已反超 OpenAI 于 run-rate 与估值），单月增量约 +$4.5B（前期约 +$17B），二阶导仍负；OpenAI 确认约 $2B/月（净约 $24B、gross-leaning 约 $33-41B）、CFO 称仍加速。两家二阶导混合（Anthropic 减速抵消 OpenAI 加速），判为『平稳/见顶迹象』黄灯（待 8 月披露确认趋势）
indicators.note_en: Stays yellow with no August print, carrying the July ledger: Anthropic's annualized ARR is ~$74.1B (having overtaken OpenAI on both run-rate and valuation), with a monthly increment of ~+$4.5B (from ~+$17B) and a still-negative second derivative; OpenAI confirms ~$2B/month (~$24B net, ~$33-41B gross-leaning) and its CFO says it is still accelerating. The two second derivatives are mixed (Anthropic decel offsetting OpenAI accel), so the read is 'flattening / topping signs' (yellow), pending an August print to confirm

indicators.threshold_text_en: <50% red / 50-65% yellow / >65% green
indicators.note: McKinsey Q1 2026：72% 企业至少 1 项 AI workload 生产化（2024 为 55%、2020 为 20%）。季度调查、本周无新 Q2/Q3 整体生产化读数，沿用 Q1；佐证：约 31% 企业已有 ≥1 个 AI agent 进入生产、约 28% 规模化。头部部署率高位、维持绿灯（Q2/Q3 整体调查待发布）
indicators.note_en: McKinsey Q1 2026: 72% of enterprises run at least one AI workload in production (vs 55% in 2024, 20% in 2020). It is a quarterly survey with no new Q2/Q3 overall print this week, so Q1 is carried; supporting data show ~31% with at least one AI agent in production and ~28% at scale. The headline rate stays high — stays green (the Q2/Q3 overall survey pending)

indicators.threshold_text: 负增长=红 / 减速=黄 / 加速=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Negative = red / Decel = yellow / Accel = green
indicators.note: 订单积压维持纪录、加速（Q2 数据、本周无新披露）：MSFT 商业 RPO $678B（+84% YoY）、Amazon RPO $496B（环比 +$132B）、Google 积压 $514B、Oracle RPO $638B，大三 hyperscaler 积压合计约 $1.69T。订单强劲且加速，维持绿灯（Oracle 客户集中于 OpenAI 仍为结构性隐患）
indicators.note_en: Backlogs stay at records and accelerating (Q2 data, no new disclosure this week): MSFT commercial RPO $678B (+84% YoY), Amazon RPO $496B (+$132B sequentially), Google's $514B backlog and Oracle's $638B RPO put big-3 hyperscaler backlog at ~$1.69T. The order book is strong and accelerating — stays green (Oracle's concentration in OpenAI remains a structural risk)

indicators.threshold_text: 停滞=红 / 放缓=黄 / 正常或加速=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Stalled = red / Decelerating = yellow / On-trend or accelerating = green
indicators.note: 前沿进展仍在轨且偏加速：困难基准数月内饱和、HLE 一年 +30pp（SOTA 约 53.3%），GPQA 头部 Gemini 3.1 Pro 94.3%/Claude Fable 5 94.1%/Opus 4.8 93.6%，SWE-bench Pro 约 80.3%；METR 倍增约 4 月轨道未放缓；近 90 天旗舰密集（Claude Opus 5 7/24、GPT-5.6 Sol、Grok 4.5 7/8）。capex 第一性支撑（模型持续变好解锁场景）完好，维持绿灯（对台账上期无实质放缓）
indicators.note_en: Frontier progress stays on-trend and if anything accelerating: hard benchmarks saturate within months, HLE gained +30pp in a year (SOTA ~53.3%), GPQA leaders are Gemini 3.1 Pro 94.3% / Claude Fable 5 94.1% / Opus 4.8 93.6%, and SWE-bench Pro ~80.3%; METR's doubling holds a ~4-month track. Flagships clustered in the last 90 days (Claude Opus 5 on July 24, GPT-5.6 Sol, Grok 4.5 on July 8). The first-principles support for capex (models keep improving, unlocking use cases) is intact — stays green (no material slowdown versus the prior ledger)

indicators.threshold_text: 任何=红 / 调查=黄 / 无=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Any confirmed = red / Investigation = yellow / None = green
indicators.note: 本周核心 AI 龙头无新增正式执法：现有条目均为私人证券诉讼（CoreWeave 集体诉讼、Oracle 债权人诉讼），Nvidia→OpenAI→CoreWeave/Oracle 循环融资/round-tripping 仍属分析师/批评者审视（WSJ、Bloomberg circular-deals 图解、Burry），无监管正式立案。round-tripping 议论量随 Nvidia $250B OpenAI 背书进一步升温（黄色隐忧），但核心龙头未触及、无 AI 专项欺诈执法，维持绿灯
indicators.note_en: No new formal enforcement against a core AI bellwether this week: existing items are private securities litigation (the CoreWeave class action, the Oracle bondholder suit), and the Nvidia->OpenAI->CoreWeave/Oracle circular-financing/round-tripping loop remains analyst/critic scrutiny (WSJ, Bloomberg's circular-deals graphics, Burry) with no formal probe. Round-tripping commentary intensified further with Nvidia's $250B OpenAI backstop (a yellow-tint concern), but core leaders remain untouched and there is no AI-specific fraud enforcement — stays green

indicators.threshold_text: 加息=红 / 通胀压力=黄 / 降息=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Hike = red / Inflation pressure = yellow / Cut = green
indicators.note: 维持黄灯，但本周是全期最动荡的一次：油价破 $100 令 8/4 CME FedWatch 对 9 月加息定价飙至约 55-82%（一周前仅约 1/3），一度逼近『隐含加息=红』；随后 8/8 疲软 7 月非农（-2.3 万 vs 预期 +8.3 万、前值下修 14.6 万）令加息预期崩塌，9 月『维持』概率回到约 60%。下次会议隐含仍是维持，故未改判红；但曲线整体转鹰（10 月加息约 55%、12 月约 75%）叠加油价通胀，是黄区内边际恶化，同时弱就业把滞胀风险摆上台面——两侧风险同时加大
indicators.note_en: Stays yellow, but this was the most volatile week of the run: oil breaking $100 sent CME FedWatch's September hike pricing to ~55-82% on Aug 4 (from ~one-in-three a week earlier), briefly nearing an 'implied hike = red'; then a weak July jobs report on Aug 8 (-23k vs +83k expected, 146k of downward revisions) collapsed hike expectations, pushing the September 'hold' probability back to ~60%. The next meeting still implies a hold, so no re-rating to red; but the whole curve turned hawkish (Oct hike ~55%, Dec ~75%) and, with oil-driven inflation, is a marginal deterioration within the yellow band, while soft jobs put stagflation risk on the table — risk rising on both tails

indicators.name_zh: 资本开支指引市场反应
indicators.threshold_text: 系统性惩罚=红 / 偶发=黄 / 奖励=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Systematic punishment = red / Episodic = yellow / Rewarded = green
indicators.note: 维持黄灯：Q2 财报季已结束、本周无新 capex 指引反应可读，沿用上期『选择性/偶发惩罚』判定——市场奖励有需求佐证的 capex（MSFT/Amazon）、只惩罚烧现金无对价者（Meta）。反应函数处红黄之间，Nvidia 8 月下旬财报为下一读点，维持黄灯
indicators.note_en: Stays yellow: Q2 season is over with no new capex-guidance reaction to read this week, carrying the prior 'selective/episodic punishment' call — the market rewarded capex backed by demand (MSFT/Amazon) and punished only cash-burning capex without receipts (Meta). The reaction function sits between red and yellow; Nvidia's late-August print is the next read — stays yellow

indicators.threshold_text: 普遍承认过热=红 / 部分=黄 / 无=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Widespread acknowledgment = red / Partial = yellow / None = green
indicators.note: 对冲表态持续但未成一致：Sam Altman 本月以 dot-com 泡沫类比 AI（『聪明人会对一颗真理内核过度兴奋』、称三人团队却融数亿的估值『疯狂』、被问投资者是否过热答『是』），但长期框定为『巨大净赢』；Pichai 反向看多、称 AI 是『快 10 倍、大 10 倍的工业革命』，投资合理。各家仍集体加码 capex、无一在承认过热同时收缩支出，维持黄灯
indicators.note_en: Hedging continues but is not universal: Sam Altman this month likened AI to the dot-com bubble ('smart people get overexcited about a kernel of truth', called three-person teams raising hundreds of millions 'insane', and said 'yes' when asked if investors are overexcited) while framing the long term as 'a huge net win'; Pichai is bullish, calling AI 'an industrial revolution 10x faster and 10x larger' and the spend justified. All majors keep raising capex and none is conceding an overheated market while cutting spend — stays yellow
